components.purpose: Display stable source identity such as Workbook p.98 - Box 5.
Reproduce only source lines needed for the task.
Visually mark exact source evidence used by the answer.
Expose the small set of words the child should carry into the answer.
Turn evidence or classifications into a short response using a frame when needed.
components.must_not: reveal answer before attempt unless worked example

components.purpose: Visible independent attempt before progressive help.
Show the verified/derived answer after attempt.
Require transfer to a new lexical/source surface after strong support.
Stable grammar taxonomy cards bound to the source model.
Stable adjective-order visual using only source-supported categories.
Mark describing words outside the school taxonomy without creating a new category.
Show concrete child questions such as Who? / Whose?
One bounded model, not a block of solved examples.
Writing space proportional to the requested output.
One fully modelled example before guided practice.
components.must_not: become a passive block of solved items
